preservation_policy.statement: Original repositories remain preserved and independently usable. Axiom is the canonical future integration target; source repositories remain provenance and upstream capability references unless explicitly retired.
preservation_policy.internal_namespace: The superforge Python package namespace is intentionally retained during consolidation for import compatibility. It is not the product identity.

snapshot_status.note: components/source_snapshots are reference copies used during consolidation. This manifest does not claim those copies are byte-identical to every current upstream head. Current source-repository heads above remain the provenance authority for their original products.

release_verification.windows_test_scope: source tests, frozen executable, route health, Inno installer, real install, installed launch, payroll route, uninstall, data-preservation check
release_verification.linux_test_scope: source tests, frozen executable, route health, tar package, user-local install, installed launch, methods/payroll routes, uninstall, data-preservation check
